Lincoln City 1-3 Birmingham City: August Priske scores twice in Blues win
Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Lincoln City and Birmingham City at the ProAmpac Stadium on Saturday; August Priske nets twice as Blues return to winning ways.
Saturday 31 October 2026 16:11, UK
August Priske scored twice as Birmingham bounced back from defeat at Cardiff to beat Lincoln 3-1 in the Sky Bet Championship at the ProAmpac Stadium.
The big Dane scored either side of the break, with Alex Cochrane securing the win after Imps substitute Tom Bayliss had reduced the deficit.
Ukrainian midfielder Ivan Varfolomeev's recall for the injured Conor McGrandles was Lincoln's only change, while for the Blues Ethan Laird came in for Bright Osayi-Samuel, with Priske and Patrick Roberts replacing Luis Vasquez and Carlos Vicente respectively.
Cochrane fired the game's first effort wide inside four minutes, before Lincoln were denied by the goal frame four minutes later.
Reeco Hackett flicked a ball through for Ben House to run on to, he backheeled a pass to Mikkel Ladefoged, who hit a low shot past James Beadle, but which bounced against the goalkeeper's right-hand post and away to safety.
In what was a hectic opening quarter of an hour, Jay Stansfield almost produced a goal of the month contender as he flicked the ball over his head when tightly marked in the City box, span round and fired just wide.
But seconds later, Birmingham were ahead, with a goal owing to some fortune on their part. A Blues pass was inadvertently directed towards his own goal by Yunus Konak, straight to Priske on the edge of the box and he swivelled and fired a low shot into the bottom corner.
Laird could have seen red after half an hour after attempting to bring down a clearance on the visitors' right wing, but booting House in the face as the Lincoln forward attempted to seize possession and nip in towards goal. Referee Lewis Smith produced only a yellow card.
Dom Jefferies' low shot was comfortably saved by Beadle deep into first-half stoppage time, before the keeper then somehow kept our Deji Elewere's close-range prod, palming his shot up onto the bar and out for a corner.
Former Imps keeper Ryan Allsopp replaced Beadle at the break, with Priske testing George Wickens after 49 minutes from the edge of the box.
On the hour mark, Blues doubled their lead. A long throw into the box was flicked on and there was Priske to slide in and poke the ball past Wickens.
There minutes later, though, Lincoln reduced the deficit through Bayliss. Ladefoged laid the ball off to the substitute and he arrowed a ball into the corner of the net.
A terrific 50-yard run from Millar nearly ended with a goal for Stansfield, but his shot was deflected wide, but less than a minute later, Cochrane was given too much time and space in the centre of the pitch to run forward and plant a left-footed shot past Wickens after 73 minutes to make it 3-1.
Elewere blocked a goal bound Stansfield shot and Demarai Gray blasted wide when through on goal as Blues looked for a fourth.

The managers
Lincoln's Chris Cohen:
"If you give away the goals we gave away, then the good bits don't really matter that much. We've got to get back to not giving up big chances, back to being hard to beat and we need to double down on that stuff.
"I thought we were a big threat in the first half, but if you give up big chances to good teams then you're going to get punished.
"If we'd have played exactly the same in the second half as we did the first half then we'd have got something out of the game. Ultimately we weren't able to do that."
Birmingham's Chris Davies:
"He not only scored the goals, but gave us a real focal point, with his size and his strength. It was a very good day for him.
"He's very mature for his age and he has all the tools, the temperament, the technical skills, the physicality and again he just needs to keep hungry, keep pushing as there's plenty more goals out there for him.
"I'm really pleased, it's a tough place to come. We were wary of the threats Lincoln had especially on the back of beating Burnley 4-1 here last week.
"I thought we were worthy of the three points this week, we were the better team. It was important to bounce back from defeat and it was a very good win. It shows real growth from us.
"It was competitive, a lot of bouncing balls, second balls, set-pieces, direct play… you're going to get that and the players came out of it well."
digest_he:
ברמינגהאם סיטי התאוששה מההפסד לקארדיף עם ניצחון חוץ מרשים 3-1 על לינקולן סיטי במסגרת הליגה. מי שהוביל את הקבוצה לניצחון היה החלוץ הדני אוגוסט פריסק, שכבש צמד שערים חשובים שהבטיחו את שלוש הנקודות לחבורה של כריס דייוויס.

פריסק פתח את החגיגה בדקה ה-16 לאחר ניצול טעות בהגנת המארחת, והוסיף את השני שלו בדקה ה-60 בבעיטה מקרוב לאחר זריקת חוץ ארוכה. על אף ששחקן לינקולן תום באייליס צימצם את התוצאה זמן קצר לאחר מכן, אלכס קוצ'יין הבקיע את השער השלישי בדקה ה-73 וחתם את תוצאת המשחק.

המאמן כריס דייוויס שיבח בסיום את יכולתו הפיזית והטכנית של פריסק ואת האופי שהפגינה קבוצתו בהתאוששות מהירה מההפסד הקודם. הניצחון ממקם את ברמינגהאם בעמדה טובה להמשך העונה בליגת המשנה.
